verdict.rationale: Vendor docs explicitly confirm customizable fields and workflows (jira-docs-3), and community feedback corroborates general customization strength (jira-comm-3). However, multiple community accounts note that this flexibility requires dedicated admins and often devolves into a bloated, hard-to-manage 'forest' of statuses/fields (jira-comm-12, jira-comm-14), indicating real-world friction in maintaining a clean, team-specific process.
